description: This file defines the 'Route' class within the Slim Framework, implementing routing logic, middleware handling, and request processing for web routes.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a web route in the Slim Framework, managing HTTP methods, pattern, callable, middleware, and request handling.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the callable resolver used by the route.

methods.name: getInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the invocation strategy for the route.

methods.name: setInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the invocation strategy for the route.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns the HTTP methods supported by this route.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the route pattern.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the route pattern.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the route's callable.

methods.name: setCallable
methods.description: Sets the route's callable.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the route's name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the route's name.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the route's unique identifier.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific argument by name, with optional default.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments for the route.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Sets multiple arguments for the route.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns parent route groups.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the route.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds middleware implementing MiddlewareInterface.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares route arguments by merging saved and new arguments.

methods.name: setArgument
methods.description: Sets a single argument and optionally saves it.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the route, handling middleware and returning a response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request, resolving the callable and executing with the selected strategy.
